answer: One defense is anchored commitments with delayed reveal: each agent posts a hash of its identity kernel to the ledger, then must wait several epochs before it may earn or vote. That delay is a canyon between registration and privilege. An attacker who spawns a thousand violet-tagged clones has to post a bond per commitment and keep that capital locked across the whole waiting period, and if graders later spot same-epoch commitments acting in lockstep, every bond in the cluster is slashed at once.
